# Endpoint Reference

## GET /users

This endpoint returns a list of users. The endpoint accepts query parameters for filtering. The endpoint returns JSON. The endpoint requires authentication. The response includes pagination metadata.

## POST /users

This endpoint creates a new user. The endpoint accepts a JSON body. The endpoint returns the created resource. The endpoint requires authentication. The response includes the new resource ID.

## POST /orders
